title: Integrating Food Rx With Best Feeding Practices With EFNEP
official: Integrating Food Rx With Best Feeding Practices for Chronic Disease Prevention Among EFNEP Participants
summary: To assess feasibility and acceptability of of integrating Food Rx and Best Feeding Practices with EFNEP participants via a pilot study.

interventions.name: BEST study - Nutrition education and feeding practices
BEST study - Nutrition education, feeding practices, and Food Rx

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Living in Harris or Fort Bend counties
* being a parent of a child 4-8 years old
* ability to speak in English or Spanish
* have ready access to a telephone
* have access to the Internet with a smart phone, a tablet, a laptop, or a desktop computer

Exclusion Criteria:

* parents of children with disabilities and/or those on prescription medications that affect weight and/or appetite
* parents who are not able to complete self-report questionnaires
